board: Sensor Maestros smSENSR-Si7006 breakout (6 pins, DIP-6 style: 1 VDD, 2 GND, 3 N/C, 4 N/C, 5 SCL, 6 SDA)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico. The no-hold commands 0xF5/0xF3 return 12-bit RH and 14-bit T with the datasheet's fixed low bits and a CRC-8 (poly 0x31, init 0x00); 0xE0 returns the last RH-cycle temperature with no CRC. No widely sold single-row Si7006 module was found, so the board is modelled with the DIP-6 footprint its two 0.3"-spaced rows match.
